Check blanket type, controls and care instructions

A heated throw and a fitted bed blanket serve different uses

Confirm whether the product is intended to go over you, under a sheet or on a particular mattress. Compare the heated area, not only the fabric dimensions, and check whether a larger bed size has separate controls. Automatic shutoff is useful only when its timing suits the intended use. Do not infer overnight suitability from the number of heat settings.

The instructions are part of the purchase

Obtain the exact care and use instructions before ordering, including washing, drying, folding and permitted bedding arrangements. Inspect used or open-box stock carefully and check the model against recall notices. CPSC's electrical-safety checklist stresses following blanket instructions. CPSC home electrical safety checklist. Stop using damaged equipment and follow the manufacturer's guidance; a bargain price is not evidence of safety.

Instead, we focus on products that demonstrate strong value, positive seller signals and a credible marketplace track record. Although we have not physically tested every item featured, our methodology is designed to help consumers make informed and confident purchasing decisions. Where performance, safety or durability are especially important, we also encourage checking independent reviews of the exact model.
